definitions.explanation: A question word asking about time. Used to inquire when something happens, happened, or will happen.

examples.japanese: いつ{日本|にほん}に{来|き}ましたか？
examples.english: When did you come to Japan?

examples.japanese: いつでも{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}です。

notes: One of the essential question words (5W1H). Related expressions: いつも (always), いつか (someday), いつでも (anytime), いつまでも (forever).
